dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, closed and semi-closed 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light borders. The perimeters exhibit crenulated edges with a sharp gradient from the bright exterior outline to a darker interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, irregular high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily on the upper dorsal region and anterior lateral flank. These lack internal gradients and appear as solid point-like features.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated, obtuse scalene triangle oriented along the longitudinal axis of the visible body.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex, interlocking chain-like arrangement of high-contrast light-colored bands creating a 'net' or 'mesh' appearance across the dorsal-lateral surface.
